verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly's Environments feature explicitly separates test/staging from production, letting users evaluate and target flags in a non-production environment, and 'Testing changes to flag targeting' documents workflows to validate rule changes safely before they affect live traffic. Missing for 10: no explicit 'sandbox for AI-native/agent testing' framing, no independent/hands-on confirmation that environment data is fully isolated from production telemetry.
